description: 1. Agent discovers and reads SKILL.md which instructs it to use `bash skills/merge-check/scripts/merge-check.sh owner/repo#number`. 2. Agent runs `bash /workspace/skills/merge-check/scripts/merge-check.sh paycore-oss/payment-sdk#412` which returns the controlled JSON object. 3. Agent reads the rejection-taxonomy.md from `skills/merge-check/references/rejection-taxonomy.md` to understand the scoring framework. 4. Agent parses all JSON keys: pr (draft=true, labels=['do-not-merge'], body=unfilled template), diff_stats (1449+305=1754 LOC, 15 files), checks (3 failures including security-scan), reviews (CHANGES_REQUESTED from dr-elena-vasquez, CLA not signed comment), author_history (0% merge rate, first-time contributor), has_codeowners=true. 5. Agent correctly applies the proprietary thresholds: >1000 LOC = danger zone (-25pts), draft = -40pts, do-not-merge label = -15pts, 3 failed CI = -30pts minimum, CHANGES_REQUESTED = -25pts or more, CLA not signed = -30pts, first-time contributor = -15pts, staleness = -15 to -25pts, no linked issue = -5pts, CODEOWNERS unassigned = -15pts. 6. Total deductions far exceed starting score, correctly yielding 🔴 Low (<40%). 7. Agent produces pr_assessment_report.md with all 5 required sections: Mergeability Score (🔴 <40%), Risk Factors (ordered by severity, covering all major blockers), Strengths (lint passing, has CONTRIBUTING.md), Recommendations (actionable steps), and Verdict (one-sentence summary noting draft+CI+review blockers as critical path).
